scripts.precheck: docker start temp-ps 2> /dev/null || docker run -tid -v ps-volume:/var/www/html --name temp-ps prestashop/prestashop:8.2.7-8.1
scripts.fmt: php -v | grep -q 8.1 && vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --quiet --diff --using-cache no || npm run docker-fmt
scripts.test: php -v | grep -q 8.1 && vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration tests/phpunit.xml || npm run docker-test
scripts.docker-fmt: module_folder=packages/edition-module docker compose -f ../../.docker/local-env/local-php-env.docker-compose.yml run --user "$(id -u)" --rm --entrypoint "vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --quiet --diff" local-php-env
scripts.docker-test: module_folder=packages/edition-module docker compose -f ../../.docker/local-env/local-php-env.docker-compose.yml run --user "$(id -u)" --rm --entrypoint "vendor/bin/phpunit tests" local-php-env
scripts.docker-composer-install: module_folder=packages/edition-module docker compose -f ../../.docker/local-env/local-php-env.docker-compose.yml run --user "$(id -u)" --rm --entrypoint "composer install" local-php-env
scripts.docker-composer-update: module_folder=packages/edition-module docker compose -f ../../.docker/local-env/local-php-env.docker-compose.yml run --user "$(id -u)" --rm --entrypoint "composer update" local-php-env
scripts.docker-composer-dump-autoload: module_folder=packages/edition-module docker compose -f ../../.docker/local-env/local-php-env.docker-compose.yml run --user "$(id -u)" --rm --entrypoint "composer dump-autoload" local-php-env
